<div class="page-intro">

I am a Data Science and Analytics Leader with 15+ years of experience building analytics capabilities, leading multidisciplinary teams and turning data into measurable business impact.

My background spans product analytics, commercial analytics, experimentation and machine learning across PayPal, Philip Morris International and Accenture. I am most effective where the problem is ambiguous, the evidence needs careful interpretation and several teams must align around a practical decision.

## How I work

I combine three perspectives that are often treated separately:

::: {.about-grid}

::: {.about-card}

### Business strategy

I start with the decision: what must change, who will act and what evidence would be useful? From there, I clarify the problem, success measures and where analytics can create meaningful value.

:::

::: {.about-card}

### Data science

I use experimentation, causal inference, predictive modeling and product analytics to produce recommendations that are technically sound and practical to implement.

:::

::: {.about-card}

### Leadership

I build teams, operating models and measurement systems that allow analytics to scale beyond individual projects and become part of how an organization makes decisions.

:::

:::
